text: 🚨🇲🇽 ICE plans electric-shock gauntlets for raids. Mexico has filed complaints over deaths in US detention. "We do not agree with raids or with the violation of the human rights of any person — particularly of a Mexican who went to the United States to earn a living." — President Claudia Sheinbaum Foreign Secretary Roberto Velasco will detail next Wednesday the complaints filed over the deaths of Mexicans in ICE custody and during detentions.
banner: ICE SHOCK GAUNTLET: MEXICO FILES COMPLAINTS

text: 🔥🇲🇽 PRI leader asks Washington to strip visas from Mexico's electoral officials. "The president of a near-extinct political party goes to the United States to ask them to take away visas. He no longer believes in Mexico, nor in Mexicans." — President Claudia Sheinbaum Alejandro Moreno filed a complaint with the US State Department after electoral authorities sanctioned him. Meanwhile, the Campeche state prosecutor is detaining former officials from his time as governor.

🇲🇽📺 79% of Mexicans back sanctioning media that deceive audiences, national poll shows. "As President López Obrador used to say: 'Fool is he who thinks the people are fools.'" — President Claudia Sheinbaum Poll presented at the mañanera: 78% say outlets must clearly separate news, opinion and paid content; 86% back regulating minors' access to social networks. The government's actual proposal: a code of ethics and an audience ombudsman in each outlet.
banner: "FOOL IS HE WHO THINKS THE PEOPLE ARE FOOLS"

text: 🔥🇲🇽 PAN demands a "right of reply" slot inside the mañanera. Sheinbaum: build your own space. "Everyone has their own space. This is the people's space — the people's mañanera. If people watch us, it's because they like it." — President Claudia Sheinbaum The PAN's congressional group formally requested airtime in the daily press conference to counter "false facts." Sheinbaum recalled the PRIAN candidate's own morning show in 2024 — it didn't last.

🇲🇽📈 Customs revenue hits 2026 record: 131 billion pesos collected in July. "Customs that only worked 10 hours a day now work 24. Around a thousand young people were hired — new, without any vices. That has helped a lot." — President Claudia Sheinbaum The National Customs Agency reported its highest monthly collection of the year. New 24/7 operations, faster cargo clearance, and a monitoring center in Querétaro.

🇲🇽🌎 Mexico sets 5 tourism records in H1 2026 — 51.1 million international travelers, up 7.7%. "We reached 51.1 million, 7.7 percent more than the same period in 2025 — a historic record." — Josefina Rodríguez, Secretary of Tourism Jan–Jun 2026: 24.5M international tourists (+4.6%), 6.6M cruise passengers (+15.2%), $18.78B in visitor spending. In June, arrivals from Japan grew 131%, Colombia 74%, Brazil 30% — the World Cup effect.

🇲🇽🏭 <u>NUEVO LEÓN TOPS MEXICO IN ANNOUNCED INVESTMENT: $5.63 BILLION IN SEVEN MONTHS</u>

Per Secretaría de Economía data, Nuevo León leads all states in announced investment with $5,631 million between January and July 2026 — 12% of the national total, with 7,620 new jobs tied to the projects. Capital keeps flowing into advanced manufacturing, mining and energy in Mexico’s north. As El Economista reports, the region keeps deepening its integration into North American value chains, tariff noise notwithstanding.

🇲🇽⚖️ <u>SCJN: JUDGES CAN NO LONGER UNBLOCK ACCOUNTS FROZEN BY THE UIF</u>

Mexico’s Supreme Court, backing Minister María Estela Ríos’s project, struck down two jurisprudences that let suspects quickly unfreeze funds flagged in financial-crime investigations. Courts can no longer suspend the Financial Intelligence Unit’s account freezes — closing a loophole that launderers abused for years. The elected Court keeps siding with the state’s power to follow dirty money.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>32,824 FIREARMS SEIZED UNDER SHEINBAUM — AND THE TRAIL LEADS NORTH</u>

Security chief Omar García Harfuch reports Sinaloa concentrates about 20% of the 32,824 guns seized in this administration — most of them trafficked from the United States. Mexico tracks them through ATF’s eTrace system while Sheinbaum keeps demanding Washington hold up its end: “Hemos pedido que haya todavía más trabajo en Estados Unidos para evitar que lleguen armas a México.” Shared responsibility is not a one-way street.

🇲🇽🌊 <u>12 YEARS AFTER GRUPO MÉXICO’S TOXIC SPILL, SONORA RIVER CLEANUP ENTERS PHASE TWO</u>

Semarnat chief Alicia Bárcena launched the second remediation stage in Ures for the basin hit in 2014 by 40 million liters of acidified copper sulfate from the Buenavista del Cobre mine — a disaster that poisoned 8 municipalities and 22,000 people while the old regime looked away. This phase targets soil recovery and water-quality monitoring. Bárcena: “No están solos, venimos a escucharlos e informarles con toda transparencia.”
